## Claim amendment · Clause-② spelling · 2026-11-02T12:53Z

This card's claim wrote the narrowing declaration as `yes (narrowing)`. That is wrong. In `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `yes (narrowing)` means a diff that widens one surface and narrows another. A narrowing that widens nothing is declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. If this card ships a narrowing, the PR body and the changeset carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, naming the key once on that line. Nothing else in the claim changes.
